author: Minecraft
description:
It's March and time for another Minecraft Monthly!

If Vu can stay awake, he'll reveal the name of our upcoming game drop! And of course, we'll talk a bit more about what this adorable game drop entails. It's also awards season over in Hollywood, so we held our own awards ceremony. And if you simply love horses as much as Vu does, you'll be happy to hear we're celebrating The Year of the Horse (including a freebie).

Come join us!

Here's what's coming:
00:00 – 00:28 – Intro Time!
00:29 – 01:07 – Let’s check out what’s inside our upcoming game drop!
01:08 – 01:22 – We’ve celebrated Lunar New Year, and we got a freebie for you!
01:23 – 01:41 – Even more details about the upcoming game drop!
01:42 – 02:05 – Vu’s epic pitch idea!
02:06 – 02:19 – More, more, more about the upcoming game drop!
02:20 – 02:37 - Trumpet solo!
02:38 – 03:08 – The Java Realms Mapmaker Awards!
03:09 – 03:33 – Time to learn about cyber safety with Minecraft Education!
03:34 – 04:14 – Game drop name reveal time!
title: REVEALING NEXT GAME DROP NAME! | MINECRAFT MONTHLY
